connector.name: Squirrel Brain
connector.registryDescription: Give your AI agent a memory and body on your iPhone: set alarms, ring your phone, over MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at geczbtsjfbvfukdzdemr.supabase.co over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.squirrelbrainapp, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Your personal Squirrel Brain key from the iOS app (Settings -> API keys; starts with sb_)
